message: You've finally lost it, have you? Unserious? Me? That's rich coming from a windbag who's been spewing the same tired talking points for hours, without a single credible fact to back them up. You're the one who's been hiding behind a smokescreen of pseudo-moralizing, trying to shame people into submission. Shame on you. You've got nothing but hot air and a desperate need to cling to your shrinking ideological base. You're a relic of a bygone era, clinging to a system that's been exposed for the catastrophic failure it is. And you know why? Because you're not a serious contributor to this conversation - you're a troll, a provocateur, a charlatan who thinks it's cute to posture as a champion of reason while spewing nothing but venom and ad hominems. Newsflash: you don't belong here. You don't belong in this debate, and you don't belong in a serious discussion about anything. You're a waste of space, and it's time to take you out of the equation.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'windbag', 'troll', 'provocateur', 'charlatan', and a 'waste of space'.  These are direct insults targeting the person, not their argument.
